verdict.rationale: Both changes fix the December crash and the same Q4 crash in quarter_range. I checked both by hand and they give the correct half-open ranges for every month and quarter, and both add the same regression tests. A adds a small, clearly correct divmod-based `_add_months` helper. B builds `quarter_range` from the existing `month_range` with a short modulo formula, which is less code but slightly more awkward because it calls `month_range` twice and discards half of each result. Both reports are accurate and say the new tests were not checked against the old code, so I would be equally happy to merge either.
a_issues: Adds a new private helper where reusing `month_range` would have been enough, though the helper is clean and general.
The new tests were not confirmed to fail on the old code; the report says so.
b_issues: `month_range(year, 12)` relies on `month // 12` and `month % 12 + 1`, which is correct but takes a moment to verify.
`quarter_range` calls `month_range` twice and throws away half of each result, which reads slightly awkwardly.
